title: run_from and ask_from flush the file logger through a barrier with a 5 s default timeout (sc-observability 1.5.0, DEFAULT_WRITER_SHUTDOWN_TI
description: run_from and ask_from flush the file logger through a barrier with a 5 s default timeout (sc-observability 1.5.0, DEFAULT_WRITER_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT and flush_with_timeout in runtime.rs). If the writer stalls past 5 s, flush returns Err. compose.rs turns that into a response warning ('session log was not flushed'). The test discards response.warnings() from both calls and then reads the JSONL file, so a flush timeout appears only as an opaque row-count assertion (rows.len() == 1 or == 2). That is intermittent under load and does not name its cause.
